name: EH3D-SERVER
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: the center of the EH3D programs. EH3D-DRILLPRO, EH3D-ROUTEPRO and, later, the Android app, the Studio and the panel next to the machine send it jobs (holes and paths, or an Excellon or HP-GL file with its tool table); it plans them with the libraries of the programs, using the constants and the tuning of the machine they are for, shows a preview, and runs them on the machine through its node (or a simulator), with the dialogs of the operator, a stop, and every change told over a websocket. Users with three roles, tokens for programs, one job at a time on a machine, and a job never starts by itself. Tested on a computer against the simulator; nothing has run on a real machine through it, and it does not terminate TLS yet.
